items.definition:
not smooth or gentle
The road was rough and bumpy.

relating to actual experience or use
It's a practical solution to the problem.

lasting for only a limited period of time
This is just a temporary solution.

ordinary, usual, or happening every day
Brushing your teeth is an everyday activity.

evoking admiration through size, quality, or skill
Her performance was truly impressive.

not firmly or tightly fixed in place
The button on my shirt is loose.

quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences
She is very sensitive to criticism.

having a large distance between two sides
The book has a thick cover.

using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something
The storm was very violent, with strong winds and heavy rain.

done in accordance with rules of convention or etiquette; suitable for an official or important occasion
You need to wear formal clothes for the interview.

not guilty of a crime or offense
The jury found the defendant innocent.

unusual
It's unusual to see snow in April.

horrible
The weather was absolutely horrible yesterday.

mini
She bought a mini skirt.

feeling or showing confidence in oneself or one's abilities
He felt confident about passing the exam.

simple; clear; not decorated
She prefers plain clothes without any patterns.

relating to love or romance
They had a very romantic dinner by candlelight.

relating to or operated by electricity
He's training to be an electrical engineer.

anxious, uneasy
She felt nervous before her presentation.

normal, common
It was just an ordinary day.

sexually attractive
She wore a very sexy dress.

far away from other places, people, or things
They live in a remote village in the mountains.

of an acceptable standard; satisfactory
He's a decent person, always willing to help.

having an even surface
The stone felt smooth to the touch.

happening quickly and unexpectedly
There was a sudden change in the weather.

having a consistency like that of water or oil
Water is a clear liquid.

of small width in relation to length
The road was very narrow.

able to be seen
The moon was clearly visible tonight.

fast, quick
The river had a rapid current.

appropriate, fitting
This dress is suitable for the party.

working by itself with little or no direct human control
The car has an automatic transmission.

elaborate in structure or decoration; expensive
They went to a fancy restaurant.

beautiful; very attractive
She looked gorgeous in her new dress.

feeling or showing appreciation for something received or done
I am grateful for your help.

immediate
I need an instant reply to my email.

happening soon
We are preparing for the upcoming exams.

watchful and ready
The guard remained alert throughout the night.

relating to the most basic principles of a subject
He has an elementary understanding of physics.

of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly
Time is a precious commodity.

ready or likely to attack or confront; characterized by aggression
The dog's aggressive behavior worried its owner.

relating to or done with the hands
The car has a manual transmission.

situated or operating beneath the surface of the ground
The underground train system is very efficient.

steady
Keep the camera steady.

triple
They ordered a triple cheeseburger.

having a natural aptitude
She is a very talented musician.

clumsy or uncomfortable
There was an awkward silence after his comment.

having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level
She is a very intelligent student.

reliant on someone or something else
Children are dependent on their parents.

calm, quiet, without war
The lake was very peaceful at dawn.

extra, not needed for ordinary use
Do you have a spare key?

able to be agreed on or approved of
The quality of the work was acceptable.

happening often
He is a frequent visitor to the library.

extremely funny
The movie was absolutely hilarious.

showing a willingness to take risks; strong in appearance
It was a bold decision to quit her job and start her own business.

without a home
Many people become homeless due to economic hardship.

very large
The elephant was an enormous animal.

on the outside
The outer layer of the onion was dry.

jealous
He felt jealous when his friend won the award.

not supporting either side
It's important to remain neutral in an argument.

relaxed and informal
He prefers casual clothes for work.

causing a strong feeling of dislike
That smell is absolutely disgusting.

firm, rigid
My parents were very strict about bedtime.

not anticipated
The sudden rain was completely unexpected.

reasonably priced
We are looking for an affordable apartment.
